body:
Changes
- `add_workers(n; workers_per_node = k)` now packs k workers into a single scheduler allocation (one worker per GPU) instead of one allocation per worker. This is needed for clusters/queues that charge for exclusive use of nodes. Default is workers_per_node = 1 so behavior is unchanged for existing pipelines. Each worker on the same node is pinned to its own GPU by setting CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per worker (see `pbs_multi_worker_script`)
- Worker .out files now default to an auto-cleaned temp dir instead of piling up in the working directory.
title: Add workers_per_node argument to add_workers
